venuePlayBar.timeRemaining: ~{{minutes}} min play time left today (UTC) at this venue
venuePlayBar.outsideGeofence: Step inside the venue geofence to use your play time.

login.title: Cafe Social
login.subtitle: Loyalty and social play at partner cafés — games when you’re there, or at home with a subscription.
login.verifySubtitle: We sent a code to your email. Enter it below.
login.signInFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.subtitle: Sign up with your email or a social account.
signUp.verifySubtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. Enter it below.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Install and use the app anywhere: loyalty, friends, and venue perks stay available. Games are for when you’re actually at a partner café — unless you have a subscription, which also lets you play from home.
onboarding.venueBody: QR or a venue code isn’t a master key to the whole app — it checks you in for play and venue challenges while you’re on site. Away from cafés you still get loyalty and social features; games need a visit or a subscription.
onboarding.unlockBody: We can suggest a nearby partner venue. Checking in (QR or code while you’re there) turns on games for that visit. You’re always free to use the rest of the app without it.
onboarding.languageSubtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.locationBody: Choose “Always” so we can notify you when you’re near a partner with an offer (about once per venue per day) and detect when you’re at a café for games and perks. “While using the app” works too, but alerts may only fire when Cafe Social is open.
onboarding.staffBody: Verify guest perk redemptions and scan staff QR codes. Open Settings → Venue staff (staff mode) anytime.
onboarding.staffHint: If you play as a guest too, your player tips live in the main app — staff tools stay under Settings.

memberCard.title: My member QR
memberCard.lead: Show this code at the till so staff can record your visit and loyalty points. It stays the same for your account.
memberCard.scanHint: Staff scan this with the partner app — works offline once loaded on this device.
memberCard.loadError: Could not load your member card.
memberCard.offlineHint: Showing your saved card — connect to refresh if you recently registered.
memberCard.offlineNoCache: Connect once to load your personal QR, then it works offline.
memberCard.tipVisit: Staff scan this at partner cafés to log your visit and loyalty.
memberCard.tipOffline: Your QR is saved on this device and works without a connection once loaded.
memberCard.staffOwnVenueNotice: You're on staff at {{venue}}. Your member card can't be used for guest rewards here — it stays valid at every other partner venue.
memberCard.staffOwnVenueNoticeNoName: You're on staff at this venue. Your member card can't be used for guest rewards here — it stays valid at every other partner venue.
memberCard.staffOwnVenueQrHidden: QR hidden while you're at your own venue. It reappears at other venues.
memberCard.staffOwnVenueScanHint: Staff accounts can't collect guest rewards at their own venue. Visit another partner café to use your card.

friendCard.title: Friend QR
friendCard.lead: Let someone scan this code to add you as a friend instantly — no username needed.
friendCard.scanHint: They open Friends → Scan friend QR in Cafe Social and point the camera here.
friendCard.loadError: Could not load your friend QR.
friendCard.offlineHint: Showing your last saved QR — tap refresh if it has expired.
friendCard.expired: This QR has expired — tap refresh for a new one.
friendCard.tipScan: Scanning adds you as friends right away — no request to accept.
friendCard.tipExpiry: Codes expire after 24 hours. Refresh if yours is old or you hit the daily limit.

scanFriendQr.title: Scan friend QR
scanFriendQr.subtitle: Point your camera at a friend’s QR code to connect instantly.
scanFriendQr.unrecognized: That QR isn’t a Cafe Social friend invite.

settings.title: Settings
settings.memberCardHint: Personal code assigned when you sign up — scanned by staff at partner stores.
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately. Saved on this device.
settings.glossaryChallenges: Challenges — goals at a café (play, check in). May unlock a perk.
settings.glossaryPerks: Perks — rewards in your wallet. Show the code/QR to staff.
settings.glossaryOffers: Offers — promos: auto (e.g. 2× XP while you play) or claim then show your member card.
settings.glossaryPlatform: Platform rewards — Cafe Social daily/weekly quests and XP tiers.
settings.glossaryStaff: Staff: perk code = wallet reward; member card = you + pending offers.
settings.locationHint: We use your location only to suggest nearby partner venues. Deny access if you want — you can still paste a venue code when you’re there to check in for games.
settings.locationGeofenceHint: For nearby offer alerts when the app is closed, allow “Always” in iOS Settings. “While Using the App” still works for games and detection when Cafe Social is open.
settings.locationStatusWhenInUse: Current access: While Using the App
settings.locationStatusDenied: Current access: Off — enable location for nearby alerts and venue detection.
settings.locationAlwaysNeededBody: Tap Location, then choose “Always”. That lets geofence alerts reach you when the app isn’t open. If you only see “While Using the App”, allow location once with the button above, then try again.
settings.notificationsHint: Choose which kinds of pushes and emails we may send. OS notification settings always apply.
settings.pushPartnerFootnote: Venue order nudges and perk alerts still respect “Total privacy” on the server.
settings.feedbackHint: Short sounds and light vibration for navigation, rewards, guesses, matches, and lobby updates. Does not change notification sounds — use your device Settings for those.
settings.soundEffectsHint: Navigation, rewards, scans, guesses, timers, match results, and lobby events.
settings.hapticsHint: Light vibration on the same moments when your device supports it.
settings.backgroundMusicHint: Soft café loop on home and lobbies; livelier music after the match intro. Plays alongside sound effects.
settings.accountHint: Delete your account to remove your player profile and sign-in from our systems. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountBody: Your profile, progress, friends, and venue activity will be permanently removed. Historical game records may keep anonymized participation.
settings.deleteAccountConfirmBody: This is final. You will be signed out and need a new account to use Cafe Social again.
settings.deleteAccountError: Could not delete your account. Try again later.
settings.deleteAccountSubscriptionNote: Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription — manage billing in your store account.
settings.privacyHint: Discoverable: others can find you for challenges. Subscribers also see discoverable subscribers away from venues. Total privacy hides you from everyone for social features.
settings.friendInviteHint: Anyone with the link can add you as a friend after they sign in.
settings.legalHint: How we use location and notifications. Full text lives on the linked pages (required for app stores).
settings.legalDataSummary: Location: only to know you are at a partner venue. Notifications: word-match activity and optional partner venue offers if you allow them — you can turn partner offers off here; total privacy still applies on our servers for venue nudges.
settings.legalUrlMissing: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL in app config to show the privacy policy link.
settings.privacyUrlMissing: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL in app config (required for App Store / Play).
settings.termsUrlMissing: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_URL in app config (required if you sell subscriptions).
settings.staffHint: Verify guest perk codes if your venue added you as EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, or OWNER in the partner CMS.
settings.subscriptionHint: Members unlock play from home and bonus perks at select premium partner venues. Status here is what our servers have on file after the store and RevenueCat sync.
settings.subscriptionBenefitPlay: Unlimited active play at venues (no daily café play-time cap).
settings.subscriptionBenefitParties: Larger parties and more invite links for coordinating with friends.
settings.subscriptionBenefitGlobal: Word games from anywhere when the venue doesn’t need to foot traffic.
settings.subscriptionBenefitFootnote: Exact limits follow your store product — this is the intent of the tier.
settings.subscriptionPaywallLead: Subscribe in a few taps. You can restore past purchases or manage billing anytime in your store account.
settings.subscriptionUrlMissing: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_SUBSCRIPTION_URL in app config for a manage / checkout link if you offer web checkout.
settings.subscriptionRcMissingKey: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_API_KEY (or iOS/Android keys) for in-app subscriptions.
settings.subscriptionWebOnlyHint: In-app subscriptions use RevenueCat on iOS and Android. Use the web link below if your product includes web checkout.
settings.subscriptionOfferingsTitle: Subscription not ready in the app
settings.subscriptionOfferingsNoCurrent: RevenueCat has no “current” offering for this build. In the RevenueCat dashboard, set a current offering and attach monthly / yearly / lifetime products, plus a Paywall.
settings.subscriptionOfferingsNoPackages: The current offering has no packages. Add monthly, yearly, and lifetime packages and ensure products are linked.
settings.subscriptionPendingBanner: Payment went through — we’re waiting for your subscription to show up on our servers. This usually takes under a minute.
settings.subscriptionPendingFollowUp: Still not seeing “active”? The webhook may be slow. Tap refresh, try Restore purchases, or wait a minute and open this screen again.
settings.subscriptionPurchaseImmediate: You’re all set — Cafe Social Pro is active.
settings.subscriptionPurchaseError: Purchase could not be completed. Try again or use Restore purchases.
settings.subscriptionRestoreActive: Restore worked — Cafe Social Pro is active.
settings.subscriptionManageNativeError: Could not open subscription management. Try again or open App Store / Google Play subscription settings.
settings.subscriptionConfirmBody: Choose Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime. Prices come from the store. Subscriptions renew until you cancel; Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
settings.subscriptionConfirmLegal: By continuing you agree to our {{links}} (also under Legal & data above).
settings.subscriptionConfirmLegalMissing: Add privacy policy and terms URLs in the app build before store submission (Settings → Legal & data).
settings.venuePlayBudgetHint: Free tier has a daily active-play budget per venue (UTC day). Subscribers have unlimited play.
settings.venuePlayBudgetLead: Buy extra minutes with an in-app purchase (RevenueCat). You must be inside the venue geofence with location on — the credit applies to today at that venue.
settings.venuePlayBudgetFairPlay: Fair play: the free daily allowance resets each UTC day and only counts while you’re in the venue’s zone — it’s not meant to surprise you mid-game. Subscribers skip the cap; optional packs extend today at this venue only.
settings.venuePlayBudgetPickBody: Prices come from the App Store or Google Play. The grant is applied on our servers after purchase.
settings.venuePlayBudgetSuccessBody: +{{minutes}} minutes credited. You have about {{remaining}} minutes left today at this venue (UTC).
settings.venuePlayBudgetNeedVenueBody: Turn on location and stand inside the partner venue, then try again.
settings.venuePlayBudgetNoProductsBody: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_VENUE_PLAY_BUDGET_IAP_PRODUCTS in the app build (same product IDs as the server).
settings.venuePlayBudgetProductMissing: This product is not available from the store. Check RevenueCat and App Store Connect / Play Console.
settings.venuePlayBudgetPurchaseError: Purchase or server credit failed. If you were charged, use “Claim purchased play time” below while at the venue.
settings.venuePlayBudgetAlreadyClaimedBody: That purchase is already on file. About {{remaining}} minutes left today at this venue (UTC).
settings.venuePlayBudgetNothingToClaimBody: No unclaimed play-time purchases found for this account. If you were just charged, wait a minute, tap Restore purchases under Subscription, then try again at the venue.

chooseGame.title: Choose a game
chooseGame.subtitle: At a venue: games use that venue. With a subscription you can also play word games globally (no venue).
chooseGame.heroVenue: You're at a partner café — venue XP and challenges apply.
chooseGame.heroGlobal: Play word games globally with a subscription, or check in at a café.
chooseGame.heroLocked: Games at this café are locked. Pick another partner venue or play globally with a subscription.
chooseGame.xpBoostActive: {{mult}}× venue XP is active — play now to earn more.
chooseGame.dailyWordNote: Looking for the one-a-day puzzle? Open Daily word from the calendar icon above.
chooseGame.wordDescription: Multi-round clue games: solo or create/join a room. Not the same as Daily word.
chooseGame.wordNeedVenue: Word rooms need a venue check-in (or play globally with a subscription).
chooseGame.needVenue: Check in at a venue first.
chooseGame.brawlerDescription: Short arena battles with heroes and power-ups.
chooseGame.brawlerNeedVenue: Brawler needs a venue check-in (arena is tied to a location).

brawlerLobby.title: Brawler lobby
brawlerLobby.heroVenue: Queue or practice at this café’s arena.
brawlerLobby.heroGlobal: Solo practice runs locally — matchmaking pairs you with anyone in the global queue.
brawlerLobby.subtitle: Pick a hero. Solo is local practice. Queue for a 1v1 (casual or ranked) against anyone available — at a café or at home with a subscription.
brawlerLobby.heroGateBody: Move/jump arena is available for Gorgon, Tariel, Vespera, Ignis, Skater, Blondee, and TesterGolem. Pick one of them to play.
brawlerLobby.queueRankedHint: Ranked 1v1 can change your brawler and global ratings when a match is completed on both devices.
brawlerLobby.queueCasualHint: Casual 1v1: solo queue may pair you with a bot; party queue can match a friend. Ratings do not change.
brawlerLobby.queueGlobalHint: One global queue — players at any partner café and subscribers at home can be paired together.
brawlerLobby.venueRequiredQueue: Check in at a venue or subscribe to join matchmaking.
brawlerLobby.needLocationForStart: Turn on location and stand inside the venue geofence to start a timed brawler session.
brawlerLobby.mapHint: Temporary picker — Random rolls Mossy Cavern or Desert Plains for this match.

brawlerMatch.queueSubtitle: One global queue — we’ll pair you with anyone waiting in the same casual or ranked bucket (any café or home subscribers).
brawlerMatch.queueBotFillHint: If no one is available shortly, you may be paired with a bot (casual only).
brawlerMatch.queuePartyWaitHint: Waiting for a party member. If no one joins within {{seconds}} seconds, the search ends.
brawlerMatch.queueNoOpponents: No opponents found. Try again, practice vs bot, or invite a party member.
brawlerMatch.pvpPlaceholderBody: You’re paired for a venue brawl. Real-time combat between two phones is not in this build yet — go back to free the room, or play solo / vs bot from the lobby.
brawlerMatch.heroDeadBody: You're out for this match. Leave to the lobby or stay and watch until the timer ends.
brawlerMatch.playTimeExhaustedBody: You’ve used your free active play time at this venue for today (UTC). You can buy more time in the app or come back tomorrow.
brawlerMatch.gameOverHint: Play again or return to the lobby.

staff.venuesHint: Pick a venue to see today’s perk redemptions (UTC day) and optional QR verification.
staff.heroTitle: Open a venue to review today’s perk redemptions, scan guest codes, and check member visits.
staff.infoRedemptions: View and verify perk redemptions for the selected UTC day.
staff.infoScan: Scan member QR codes and staff verification codes on site.
staff.noVenues: You are not on staff for any venue yet. Ask your operator to add your email in the partner CMS.
staff.scanSubtitle: Scan a guest member QR (loyalty card) or a perk redemption code. You can also paste a code below.

staff.codeInvalid: Enter a valid 8-character code or UUID.

staff.modPartnerToolsHint: Managers can take action in the partner portal; this is a read-only signal for on-site staff.
staff.voidRewardHint: Permanently void this claim. The guest will not be able to redeem it.
staff.lockRewardHint: Guest cannot redeem until a manager unlocks. Add a short reason for your team.
staff.scanSuccessBody: QR verified and reward marked as redeemed.

atVenue.bodyCanPlay: You can still play games here. Guest perk and offer claims are handled through staff tools.
atVenue.bodyEmployeeNoGuestRewards: While you're on staff here, guest perks and offers are disabled — use staff tools to verify guests instead.
atVenue.bodyManagerNoGuestRewards: Guest rewards are disabled for your account at this venue. Use staff tools below, or manage offers in the partner portal.
atVenue.managerPortalHint: Managers and owners can edit venue content in the partner portal on the web.

home.noVenueYet: No partner venue detected. Loyalty, friends, and invites still work. Games open when you’re at a café — or from home if you have a subscription.
home.lockedHintStandard: Venue games need location to confirm you’re on site. Loyalty and browsing stay available.
home.lockedHintPremium: Venue games need location here, or use a subscription for global play from anywhere.
home.venueTemporarilyUnavailableShort: Games aren’t available at this venue for the moment.
home.bannedFromVenue: This venue has restricted your account from games and redemptions here. Contact the staff if you think this is a mistake.
home.unlockToStart: Be at the venue with location on, or subscribe for global play.
home.venueErrorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and that the app points at the right API (for example your computer’s IP on a physical device).
home.playLockedHint: Turn on location at a partner café, or use a subscription to play from anywhere.
home.explicitCheckInRequired: This café asks for a QR check-in. Scan the code at the venue (with location on) to unlock games and venue perks.
home.explicitCheckInChallengeLine: Check in with QR at this venue to continue.
home.playLockedExplicitCheckIn: This venue needs a one-time QR check-in while you’re on site. Allow location, then scan.
home.venueErrorLocationHint: If this persists, enable precise location for this app and step inside the café’s geofence.
home.startHereSubtitle: Pick one quick win — you can explore the rest anytime.
home.startSocialHint: Playing with friends? Start a party from Invites, then open Word rooms with the same venue.
home.wordGamesCardBody: Daily word is one puzzle per day with limited tries (like Wordle). Word rooms are multi-round clue games — solo or with friends in a room.
home.linkDailyWordSub: One puzzle a day · limited guesses
home.venueFeedEmpty: No recent activity yet — start a match or solve the venue daily.
home.friendsVisitedVenue: {{count}} friends have visited this venue in the last 30 days.
home.venuePerksEmpty: No public perk teasers yet — staff can still give you a code to enter below in Redeem.
home.venueVisitDays30d: {{n}} visit days here in the last 30 days

partnerMap.webListHint: Maps in the browser are limited — tap a venue for details and directions.

wordLobby.venueLineShort: Set up a game at this partner café.
wordLobby.globalLine: Global play — not tied to a venue (subscription).

parties.kickConfirm: {{name}} will be removed from this party.
parties.transferConfirm: Make {{name}} the leader? You will lose leader powers unless you are selected again.

myReports.title: Your venue reports
myReports.subtitle: Status of safety reports you sent to venue staff. Staff may leave a short note when a report is closed.
myReports.empty: You haven’t filed any reports yet.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: Connect with people you play with at partner cafés.
friends.addByUsernameHint: Search is case-insensitive. They’ll get a request to accept.
friends.requestAlreadyPending: A request already exists or you’re already friends.
friends.blockedHint: Blocked players can’t friend you or appear in your social lists. You can unblock anytime.
friends.blockConfirm: {{username}} won’t be able to send friend requests or appear in your friend features. Any pending request is removed.

rewardsHub.title: Rewards hub
rewardsHub.subtitle: QR rewards and staff codes from challenges across venues.
rewardsHub.empty: No cross-venue rewards yet. Complete a challenge with a perk reward while you’re at a café.

questHub.title: Rewards hub
questHub.subtitle: Active challenges. Earn XP, climb tiers, unlock perks.

perkWallet.title: My perk codes
perkWallet.subtitle: QR rewards and staff codes from challenges across venues.
perkWallet.empty: No cross-venue rewards yet. Complete a challenge with a perk reward while you're at a café.
perkWallet.lockedHint: This reward is locked while staff review a receipt or issue. Show your code once it is unlocked.
perkWallet.staffOwnVenueHint: You're on staff at this venue — redeeming, codes, and receipts are disabled here for your account. Rewards at other venues still work as usual.

perk.title: Redeem perk
perk.subtitle: Enter the code from the venue (you must be on premise). Staff may ask you to scan a QR for some offers.
perk.needVenue: Enable location and stand inside the partner venue zone so we can confirm you’re on site.
perk.needLocationPrecise: We need a GPS fix to verify you’re inside the venue fence. Try again outdoors or near a window.
perk.wrongVenue: You opened redeem for a different venue than where you are now. Go to the right café or open Redeem from Home.
perk.showToStaff: Show this screen to staff if they need proof.
perk.qrUnlockHint: Check in (QR or invite) may be required before redeeming this one.
perk.fullyRedeemedLabel: Fully redeemed — ask staff for new codes.
perk.staffGuestRewardsBlocked: Guest perks and offers are disabled while you're on staff at this venue. Use staff tools to verify guests.
perk.emptyAtVenue: No perks or rewards here yet — finish a challenge or ask staff for a code when offers go live.
perk.staffRewardActionsHidden: You're on staff at this venue, so this reward can't be redeemed here on your account. It stays valid at venues where you're not staff.

redeem.title: Redeem invite
redeem.heroTitle: Paste a link code from email or messages, or open a cafesocial:// invite on this device.
redeem.inputHint: Long codes are fine — we trim spaces automatically.
redeem.partyInfo: Party codes add you to a group lobby.
redeem.hint: Paste the token from a party or friend invite, or open a cafesocial:// link.

peopleHere.title: Who's here
peopleHere.subtitle: Players recently at this venue (respects privacy).
peopleHere.empty: Nobody visible right now — check discoverability in Settings or try again in a minute.
peopleHere.noParties: Create a party first from the Parties tab.

reportPlayer.title: Report a player
reportPlayer.subtitle: You’re flagging {{username}} for staff at this venue. Be specific and factual.
reportPlayer.signInRequired: Sign in to submit a report.
reportPlayer.successBody: Venue staff can review this in their partner tools. Thank you for helping keep the community safe.
reportPlayer.failed: Could not send report. Try again in a moment.
reportPlayer.footer: False or abusive reports may be reviewed. You can’t report yourself.

banAppeal.title: Appeal venue restriction
banAppeal.subtitle: Explain why you believe this restriction should be lifted. Venue managers review appeals in their tools.
banAppeal.signInRequired: Sign in to submit an appeal.
banAppeal.successBody: If managers follow up, they’ll use your account email. You can submit one open appeal per venue.
banAppeal.outcomeBodyLifted: Staff granted your appeal. You may be able to use games and redemptions at this venue again when you’re on site — pull to refresh the home screen after a moment.
banAppeal.outcomeBodyUpheld: Staff reviewed your appeal and the venue restriction is still in place. If you have new information, contact the venue directly.
banAppeal.outcomeBodyDismissed: Staff reviewed and closed your appeal without lifting the restriction. Contact the venue if you need more detail.
banAppeal.outcomeBodyOther: Staff updated your appeal. Check below for any message they left for you.
banAppeal.pendingBody: Venue managers have your message and will review it in their partner tools.

brawlerArena.leaveBody: Your current match will end if you leave now.

postGame.autoAdvanceHint: Next in a moment… tap dots to jump ahead or back.
